quests.title: Good Hunter Express

dialogue.sit: I've got some other things to do.

dialogue.t: Oh, sure. I'll go get someone else to help. That said, it's been quite dangerous outside lately.
Please remember to avoid getting hit by any element while you're on your way. Be careful now, and don't get hurt.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Hardworking Silio

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: Well, here's what happened. Silio ordered a serving of Mondstadt Hash Brown, and said that he'd like it delivered around this time.
This hash brown is particularly fragile. If you shake it too much, it might fall apart. Please deliver it in time so that it can maintain its crumbly mouthfeel.
If something happens to you out there, please bring that serving back, and I'll prepare a new one for you.
Oh wow, thanks, you're finally here!

quests.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...
